page_title: ALA 0-3 BAR | Alaves v Barcelona 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
89' The number of offsides is – 10:2.
87' Joan Jordan (Alaves) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
87' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
86' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
85' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Santiago Mourino (Alaves) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
85' Poor challenge! Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Alaves will take a free kick near the side line.
84' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) replaces Alejandro Balde.
81' Substitution. Gerard Martin (Barcelona) has come on for Inigo Martinez.
80' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
78' Kike Garcia (Alaves) gets inside the box and tries to beat Inaki Pena with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
78' Here comes a substitution. Antonio Blanco is given a rest as he is replaced by Joan Jordan (Alaves).

75' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and tries a snap shot in the vicinity of the left post, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save. The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who directs his low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to block the effort.
75' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.

74' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Ansu Fati (Barcelona) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the right side of the goal, but Antonio Sivera keeps it out with an amazing save.
71' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Inaki Pena.
69' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is repeatedly being caught offside.
68' A dangerous looking corner kick from Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is cleared to safety by the defence.
68' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
67' Substitution. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) in, Hector Fort out.
67' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Lamine Yamal and he is replaced by Ansu Fati (Barcelona).
67' Substitution. Abdel Abqar will be replaced by Adrian Pica (Alaves).
66' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
66' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is caught offside yet again.
64' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
63' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) will deliver the corner kick.

63' Ander Guevara (Alaves) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
60' Kike Garcia (Alaves) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
59' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
57' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Kike Garcia (Alaves) replaces Toni Martinez.
57' Stoichkov will be replaced by Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
57' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
55' Stoichkov (Alaves) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
54' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
54' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
53' This is a yellow card! Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
53' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short.
51' Stoichkov (Alaves) tries to find Abderrahmane Rebbach, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
50' Toni Martinez (Alaves) misses a great chance. He gets to the rebound inside the box and sees his shot smash against the left post!
50' There's an opportunity for Carlos Vicente (Alaves) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
50' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
48' Stoichkov (Alaves) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
48' The attendance for today's match is 19468.
47' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Luis Garcia Plaza has made a change at the break. Moussa Diarra (Alaves) has come on in place of Nahuel Tenaglia.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Pedri (Barcelona) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
45+5' Raphinha (Barcelona) prepares to take a corner kick.

45+4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

45+2' Ander Guevara (Alaves) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
45+2' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45+2' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Alaves players look gutted.
45+2' The Alaves players halt their celebrations as referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45' Nahuel Tenaglia produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Toni Martinez (Alaves) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:3.
45' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
44' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
40' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
40' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
36' The corner from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is cleared away by the defence.
36' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Alaves will take a corner kick.

32' 0 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Eric Garcia slips the ball through to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:3.
31' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is booked.
28' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Excellent touch by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
24' A loose ball is pounced on by Raphinha (Barcelona) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Antonio Sivera is alert and makes a comfortable save.
22' 0 - 2 Goal! Raphinha puts the ball across the area and Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 0:2.
17' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
16' The corner from Manu Sanchez (Alaves) is hurriedly cleared.
15' Stoichkov (Alaves) serves up a nice cross, but Inaki Pena punches the ball away. The ball is out of play and Alaves manage to earn a corner.
14' Toni Martinez (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Inaki Pena intercepts the ball.
10' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

7' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Raphinha flights the free kick into the box, where Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 0:1.
7' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) brings an opponent down and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game. Barcelona will take a free kick.
6' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is substituted due to injury. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Eric Garcia.
5' It doesn’t look good for Ferran Torres (Barcelona); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
5' One of the players from Alaves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' A goal, which was scored by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), was disallowed due to offside.
3' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
Alaves will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
